βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δεικνύμενος: δείκνυμι — show, point out; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’gesturing’
δόμεναί: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι), accented before the enclitic τε, complementing ἐθέλω: ’to give’
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
κέλεσθε: κέλομαι — urge, command; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’urge!’
καλήν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. sg.
κατέλεξας: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have recounted’
κηρύκων: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the heralds’
κλέα: κλέος — fame, glory, glorious deeds; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (κλέα ἀνδρῶν ’glories of men’)
κρονίδῃ: Κρονίδης — son of Cronos; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
λέβητας: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. acc. pl.
λήξειεν: λήγω — cease, leave off; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a repeated past clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he ceased’
μεγάλας: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. pl.
μελάθρῳ: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, rafter; neut. dat. sg.
μιγῆναι: μίγνυμι — mix; aor. pass. inf. ’unite with’ (+ dat.), of sexual union: ’to have lain with’
προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)
σπεῖσάν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσπεισαν)
τίσω: τίνω — pay (a penalty), pay for; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will pay’
ταφὼν: τέθηπα — be astounded; aor. part. ταφών (ἔταφον), masc. nom. sg.: ’astounded’
τελέουσι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελοῦσι)
τηλύγετος: τηλύγετος — late-born (or, on another view, tenderly loved, darling — meaning disputed, no etymology certain); masc. nom. sg.
φιλήσῃ: φιλέω — love, welcome, entertain; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’will entertain, give welcome to’
φοῖνιξ: Φοῖνιξ — a Phoenician; masc. nom. sg. (also ’palm, purple-red’)
φόρμιγγι: φόρμιγξ — lyre; fem. dat. sg.: ’lyre’ (with μολπῇ, ’song and dance and lyre’)
χαίρετον: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. imper. 2 dual: ’rejoice, welcome’
χρεώ: χρεώ — need, necessity; nom. sg., impersonal noun (σε χρεώ ’there is need on you’)
χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἀέθλια: ἀέθλιον — prize, contest (epic; cf. Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), in apposition to the subject: ἀέθλια τοῖο ἄνακτος ’prizes of that lord’
ἀείδων: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (ἀργύρεον ὑπερθύριον ’a silver lintel’)
ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐναντίος: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’facing (her)’
ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
ἐπιόψομαι: ἐφοράω — look over, inspect, single out; fut. 1 sg. ἐπιόψομαι: ’I will single out’
ἐστον: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 dual: ’you two are’
ἑαδότα: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (perf. ἕαδα): ’pleasing’, with μῦθον
ἑλέσθω: αἱρέω — take; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him take (for himself)’
ἑῇ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; epic ἑός) — his own, her own; fem. dat. sg. (with τέχνῃ)
ἔντυνον: ἐντύνω — make ready, set in train; impf. 3 pl.: ’they set going’
ἔοι: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴη)
ἔπιόν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl. (accent from the following enclitic θ’) · also aor. 1 sg. (same form): ’I drank’ (ἔφαγόν τ’ ἔπιόν τε ’I ate and drank’)
ἔωσιν: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic ἔωσιν (= Attic ὦσιν)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἰδυίας: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. pl. (also gen. sg.), epic (= Attic εἰδυίας): ’skilled in’
ὀτρύνομεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, send speeding; aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ὀτρύνωμεν) · also after μή, prohibitive: ’let us not urge on’
